Message.Name: Series Update
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate all Option series traded on MIAX for the current session on the cloud associated for this connection.

Field.Name: Product Add/Update Time
Field.Description: Time at which this product is added/updated on MIAX system today.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: MIAX Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol for the option.

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Option Security Symbol

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Expiration date of the option in YYYYMMDD format

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Explicit strike price of the option. Refer to data types for field processing notes

Field.Name: Call or Put
Field.Description: Option Type

Field.Name: Opening Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 09:30:00

Field.Name: Closing Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 16:15:00

Field.Name: Restricted Option
Field.Description: Restricted Option

Field.Name: Long Term Option
Field.Description: Long Term Option

Field.Name: Active on MIAX
Field.Description: Indicates if this symbol is tradable on MIAX in the current session

Field.Name: MIAX BBO Posting Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation as agreed to by the Options industry (penny pilot program) and as published by MIAX

Field.Name: Quote Acceptance Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation for Quote acceptance as per MIAX rules

Field.Name: Opening Underlying Market Code
Field.Description: Options opening will be triggered on receipt of Opening quote/trade from this Underlying market

Field.Name: Priority Quote Width
Field.Description: Maximum allowable width for a quote for this Option during regular trading in order to be considered as Priority Quote. 0 when Priority Quote Width is not applicable.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: ** Reserved for future use **

Message.Name: ARM Settings Update Request
Message.Description: Firms can use this message format to set up their ARM protection settings for each session. Changes to these settings can be made throughout the day.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID assigned by the firm

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: Action

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying symbol for which this ARM protection is applicable Optional: If this is filled with spaces, this ARM protection setting will be used as a default setting for this MPID.

Field.Name: Allowable Engagement Percentage
Field.Description: Percentage of quote size at which the Market Maker wants MIAX to trigger ARM protection for this underlying. Please refer to the rules for details of ARM. Minimum value is 100 (100%). Maximum is 65,535 (65,535%).

Field.Name: Counting Period
Field.Description: Duration (in number of milliseconds) in which Engagement percentage is calculated in order to determine if the MPID should be put on ARM protection for this underlying. Allowable Range: 100 to 15,000 milliseconds Must be a multiple of 100 milliseconds.

Message.Name: ARM Settings Update Response
Message.Description: MIAX uses this format to respond to the firm with a status of their ARM protection settings request.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID sent by the firm in the request

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying sent in the request. Firms can use this to know which underlying setting did not take into effect in case of an error.

Field.Name: ARM Settings Update Status
Field.Description: ARM Settings Update Status

Message.Name: Valid Quote Width for Opening
Message.Description: This message format will be used to convey to the firms the Valid Quote Width settings applicable to the Opening process of MIAX Options market. Each message describes a row of the Valid Quote Width table with a low end of the applicable price range and corresponding maximum quote width. The high end of the applicable price range is up to, but not including the next row's low end applicable price range if provided or infinity for the last row. If the table has to be reloaded, all rows will be resent. Refer to Appendix C for an example.

Field.Name: Notification Time
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by MIAX system.

Field.Name: MPV Class
Field.Description: This valid width record is applicable for Options in this MPV class

Field.Name: Low End of Applicable Range
Field.Description: Low end of the price range for which this valid width is applicable. The high end of the price range is up to, but not including the low end of next row or infinity for last row.

Field.Name: Maximum Quote Width
Field.Description: Quote width applicable for this range for Options that are not Long Term Options.

Field.Name: Long Term Option Multiplier
Field.Description: Multiplier of the maximum quote width (specified in the previous field) for this range applicable for Long Term Options.

Message.Name: Bulk Quote Message
Message.Description: Firms can use this message format to send up to 50 single sided quotes. Single sided quotes enables the firms to prioritize the update of more important quotes and sides ahead of other quotes.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID assigned by the firm

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Quote Count
Field.Description: Number of quotes in this bulk quote message.

Field.Name: Single Side Quote
Field.Description: 1 to 50 single-side quotes

Message.Name: Bulk Quote Response
Message.Description: This message format will be used to inform the firm of the status of quotes sent in the bulk quote request.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID sent by the firm in the request

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Bulk Quote Status
Field.Description: Bulk Quote Status

Field.Name: Quote Count
Field.Description: Number of quotes that were submitted in the Bulk quote block

Field.Name: Invalid Quote Count
Field.Description: Number of quotes that were rejected (quotes with status other than “ “)

Field.Name: Quote Ack Time
Field.Description: Time at which MIAX engine generated this response.

Field.Name: Single Side Quote Response
Field.Description: 1 to 50 single-side quote responses

Message.Name: Enhanced Quote (eQuote) Message
Message.Description: This is the format for an eQuote message that can be sent either to match with orders and quotes on the MIAX book or when responding to a liquidity seeking event.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID assigned by the firm

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned ID of the Market Maker This cannot be changed in a replacement eQuote.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: Product ID mapped to a given option assigned by MIAX for the current session This cannot be changed in a replacement eQuote.

Field.Name: eQuote Action
Field.Description: eQuote Action

Field.Name: eQuote Type
Field.Description: Type of eQuote

Field.Name: Event ID
Field.Description: When eQuote Type = “A”: - For Opening event, Event ID must be zero. Otherwise, eQuote will be rejected. - For other Auction/Timer events, Event ID must match the Event ID of the event in progress (MIAX Event ID that was published in the Liquidity seeking event notification) When eQuote Type is other than “A”: MIAX will ignore Event ID. Firms can send an Event ID of zero. This can be changed in a replacement eQuote.

Field.Name: Target Message ID
Field.Description: Zero if this is a new request. Otherwise, Client Message ID of the pending eQuote that is being replaced.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price up to which the Market Maker is willing to match. Max Price: 99,999.999 This can be changed in a replacement eQuote. This is ignored for eQuote cancels.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of contracts. Max Size: 999,999 This can be changed in a replacement eQuote. Not applicable for eQuote cancel because eQuote cancel request will result in entire remaining size to be canceled.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of this eQuote

Message.Name: Enhanced Quote (eQuote) Response
Message.Description: This message indicates if the eQuote was accepted or rejected. Note that this message does not report executions. For executions, please refer to the Execution notification. For the unexecuted part that gets canceled, please refer to the Cancel notification.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID sent by the firm in the request

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: eQuote ID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned ID for eQuote if accepted; Zero if eQuote was rejected. Replaced eQuote will have the same eQuote ID as original.

Field.Name: eQuote Request Status
Field.Description: eQuote Request Status

Message.Name: Mass Quote Cancel Request
Message.Description: Firms can use this message format to request the cancelation of all quotes and eQuotes for an MPID, or all quotes and eQuotes for an MPID for all series for an underlying

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID assigned for the firm

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: If filled with valid underlying, cancel request applies to the entire series of this underlying. If filled with spaces, MIAX will proceed to cancel quotes and eQuotes for all series in all underlying instruments that the MPID is eligible to trade.

Message.Name: Mass Quote Cancel Response
Message.Description: This message format will be used to inform the firm about the status of their previous mass quote cancel request.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID sent by the firm in the request

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Mass Quote Cancel Status
Field.Description: Mass Quote Cancel Status

Message.Name: Quote Protection Reset Request
Message.Description: Following a quote protection being engaged for a given MPID and underlying, firms must use this message format to reset their Quote Protection in order to start quoting for any option of the specified underlying.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID assigned by the firm

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Must be filled with a valid underlying. MIAX will remove (reset) the Quote protection for this MM for entire series of this underlying.

Message.Name: Quote Protection Reset Response
Message.Description: This message format is used to inform the firms of the status of their Quote Protection Reset request.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID sent by the firm in the request

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Quote Protection Reset Status
Field.Description: Quote Protection Reset Status

Message.Name: System State Notification
Message.Description: This message format is used to notify the firms of the state changes of the system. This is an exchange-wide notification and not a symbol or member based notification.

Field.Name: Notification Time
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by MIAX system.

Field.Name: MEI Version
Field.Description: Eg:MEI1.02

Field.Name: Session ID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned ID for the current trading session

Field.Name: System Status
Field.Description: System Status

Message.Name: Trading Status Notification
Message.Description: This message format will be used to notify the firms of changes to the trading status of an option or trigger of market-wide circuit breakers on the MIAX Options market.

Field.Name: Notification Time
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by MIAX system.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: MIAX Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Trading Status

Field.Name: Expected Event Time
Field.Description: Expected time of start of the event as specified below: When trading status=”H”, this will be 0 (zero). When trading status =”C”, this will be the time at which Closing rotation will start for this Product When trading status = “R”, this will be the time at which the reopening process will start for this Product

Message.Name: Quote Width Relief Notification
Message.Description: This message format will be used to notify the firms if and when MIAX grants relief to the valid quote width parameters for Opening as specified in the rules and regulatory circulars of MIAX Options market.

Field.Name: Notification Time
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by MIAX system.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: If filled with valid underlying, relief applies to all options symbols of this underlying. If filled with spaces, relief is an exchange-wide relief

Field.Name: Relief Multiplier
Field.Description: Relief is the multiplier times the regular acceptable quote width. Eg: For a series with quote width of $0.25, a relief multiplier of 2 implies that the acceptable quote width is $0.50.

Message.Name: ARM Protection Settings Notification
Message.Description: This message format will be used to notify firms of their ARM settings. All the ARM settings will be published upon system initialization and each subsequent change will also be published.

Field.Name: Notification Time
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by MIAX system.

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned ID of the Market Maker. MPID will be spaces for MIAX global default settings.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying symbol for which this ARM protection is applicable If this is filled with spaces and MPID is filled with valid MPID, this ARM protection setting acts as the global default setting for this MPID. If this is filled with spaces and MPID is filled with spaces, this ARM protection setting acts as the MIAX global default settings. Note that the underlying ARM setting will override the global setting.

Field.Name: Allowable Engagement Percentage
Field.Description: Percentage of quote size at which MIAX must trigger ARM protection for this MPID and underlying. Please refer to the rules for details of ARM.

Field.Name: Counting Period
Field.Description: Duration (in number of milliseconds) for which trades are considered for Engagement percentage calculation in order to determine if the MPID should be put on ARM protection for this underlying.

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: Action

Field.Name: Source
Field.Description: Source

Message.Name: Quote Protection Trigger Notification
Message.Description: This message format will be used to notify firms when an MPID is placed under quote protection. Quote protection can be triggered due to any one of the reasons listed in the message below.

Field.Name: Notification Time
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by MIAX system.

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying for which this MPID is placed in Quote protection

Field.Name: Trigger Reason
Field.Description: Trigger Reason

Message.Name: Liquidity Seeking Event Notification
Message.Description: This message format will be used to notify firms of opening imbalances and auction initiation.

Field.Name: Notification Time
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by MIAX system.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: MIAX Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Event Type
Field.Description: Type of Event: ‘L’: Liquidity Refresh Mechanism ‘O’: Opening/Reopening Imbalance Mechanism ‘R’: Route Mechanism

Field.Name: Event ID
Field.Description: Values: When Event Type is ‘O’: always 0 When Event Type is ‘L’ or ‘R’: Unique Event ID for the current event.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Current price of the Event. Usage: Please refer to Appendix D for details.

Field.Name: Imbalance Side
Field.Description: This is the side of the excess liquidity that is waiting to get matched. Usage: When Event Type is ‘O’: Imbalance Side. When Event Type is ‘R’: Side that will be routed. When Event Type is ‘L’: Side of oversized order initiating liquidity refresh. Please refer to Appendix D for details.

Field.Name: Quantity 1
Field.Description: Usage: When Event Type is ‘O’, ‘L’ or ‘R’: MatchQty - Number of contracts ready to be matched (both buyers and sellers already present). Other Event Types: 0 (zero) Please refer to Appendix D for details.

Field.Name: Quantity 2
Field.Description: Usage: When Event Type is ‘O’, ‘L’ or ‘R’: Routable Quantity. Number of contracts that may be routed. Other Event Types: 0 (zero) Please refer to Appendix D for details.

Field.Name: Quantity 3
Field.Description: Usage: When Event Type is ‘O’,‘L’ or ‘R’: Imbalance Quantity. Number of contracts on the Imbalance Side that cannot be matched. Other Event Types: 0 (zero) Please refer to Appendix D for details.

Field.Name: Quantity 4
Field.Description: Usage: When Event Type is ‘O’, ‘L’ or ‘R’: Must Fill Quantity. Number of contracts, on the provided Side, that must be matched at the provided Price. These contracts are crossing the provided Price and MIAX is seeking liquidity for these contracts. Other Event Types: 0 (zero) Please refer to Appendix D for details.

Field.Name: Attributable ID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned Attributable ID (Executing Broker MPID) of an Order. Otherwise, it is space filled.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: ** Reserved for future use. **
